name: fishing-intelligence
description: Open-source portable fishing decision intelligence with global authority resolution, trip planning, field capture, personal learning and adaptive replanning.

interface.longDescription: Portable open-source fishing decision intelligence for global trip planning, current-authority checks, field capture, personal learning and adaptive replanning. No dedicated server or persistent store is required.
defaultPrompt: Plan my next fishing trip from my target, fishing mode, available window and constraints.
Record this fishing session, including catches, blanks and effort, then help me learn from it.
Replan the rest of my active trip from the current conditions and what has happened so far.
